scientific_integrity: The exact homotopy claim rests on a complete acyclic Morse matching, verified integer boundary coefficients and the homotopy classification of maps from a three-sphere to a wedge of three-spheres. Independent finite checks corroborate; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite graph classification only, not a universal family theorem.
No equivariant homotopy splitting or inclusion-induced homology map.
Novelty assessed against accessible primary literature and records; unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Desargues perfect-matching complex
